summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated sibling payload
details: The package declares a preinstall script (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases into a temp directory, marks it executable, and uses it to execute a sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a ~728KB heavily obfuscated bundle (hex-mangled identifiers, a shuffled string/opcode array, and a rotator function characteristic of obfuscator.io-style string-array VMs). The package is published under the `@ornikar` scope and advertises itself as a GraphQL config utility (`description: graphql config and checks`), which has no functional relationship to fetching an alternate JavaScript runtime or executing an opaque bundle at install time. Installing this version via `npm install` unavoidably fetches Bun and runs the obfuscated payload on the installer's host, bypassing Node-based inspection of the executed code. The delivery shape (alternate-runtime dropper + obfuscated in-tarball payload + purpose mismatch with the advertised package) is consistent with scope impersonation or a compromised publisher account distributing malware under a first-party-looking name.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
